rung means it: a claim about ONE state of the code, which must be NEWER than
the code it vouches for. test_workshop_walk.py enforces that.
It does NOT claim the guide is correct. It claims someone checked, and when.
The distinction is the whole point: absence of a walk is not a pass.

the HEAD you walked. Do not bump the SHA to make a red test go green.
